name: USS Indianapolis
shortDescription: Portland-class heavy cruiser with hard-hitting 203mm guns and the longest-ranged radar at her tier, but a huge, thin-skinned broadside.

consumables.name: Damage Control Party
consumables.flavor: Unlimited charges, 5s action, 60s cooldown. Standard for the tier, nothing extra.

consumables.name: Sonar
consumables.flavor: 2 charges, 94s active on a 180s cooldown. Tags ships out to 4.2 km and torpedoes at 2.9 km, including through smoke.

consumables.name: Surveillance Radar
consumables.flavor: 2 charges, 25s active on a 180s cooldown, 9.9 km range, longer reach than Atlanta or Baltimore get at their own tiers.

consumables.name: Defensive AA Fire
consumables.flavor: 2 charges, 40s active on a 150s cooldown, +200% average AA damage. Stock numbers for the type.

turrets.note: Superfiring over turret 1, same forward-friendly coverage.

strengths: 9.9 km Surveillance Radar range beats Atlanta and Baltimore, the two other tier VI/VIII US radar cruisers
4,600 AP damage per shell and Sticky Shot trait punish broadside cruisers and battleships that show any angle
32,500 hp hull is a deep pool for a tier VI cruiser, most of her tier's line ships need an upgraded hull to match it
11.8 km sea detection is tight for a heavy cruiser, helps her open engagements on her own terms
weaknesses: 14.3s reload is slower than New Orleans' stock 13.5s and well behind Yorck's 10s, so DPM lags peers with similar guns
13-146mm armor and a long hull mean an easy citadel the moment she's caught broadside
No torpedoes at all, zero threat if a fight closes to brawling range
No upgrade path to lean on later, the stats she has stock are the stats she keeps for good
tips: Fight at range and keep some angle on. That citadel is real and battleships will find it.
Pop Radar when you need to confirm a target through smoke, 9.9 km covers more of the map than most cruisers can manage.
Lead with AP against anything broadside, the 4,600 damage per shell adds up fast across nine guns.
Don't try to out-brawl anything up close, she has no torpedoes and no armor to back up a close fight.

threats.threat: Battleships at any range she's spotted
threats.reason: Thin armor and a big broadside make her a reliable citadel target.
No torpedoes and a slow-turning reload leave her with nothing to answer a close-range brawl.

summary: Long-range heavy cruiser, nine 203mm guns in three triple turrets, two forward and one aft.
Hard-hitting AP and the longest radar range at her tier, but a slow reload holds her DPM back.
Big and thin-skinned. A caught broadside is a citadel, not a close call.
playstyle.detail: Indianapolis plays like most Portland-class cruisers should: sit at range, put AP into anyone who shows a flank, and use Radar to keep tabs on smoked-up targets other cruisers can't see. The guns hit hard per shell but reload slowly enough that sustained pressure isn't her strength, she wins exchanges on alpha damage, not rate of fire. The tradeoff for that firepower and hit point pool is a long, thin-skinned hull with no torpedoes to fall back on, so the whole game is staying at an angle and picking fights she starts.

captainsNotes: She's slow and fragile and feels most suitable for sniping, and supporting with the sonar.

goalTags.note: 9.9 km Surveillance Radar range is the longest of any US cruiser at tier VI or VIII, genuinely useful team spotting tool.
